verdict.rationale: Foreloop is an AI-powered SaaS that reviews pull requests and processes user feedback, so a training opt-out is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions AI training, data-use policies, or any opt-out control. The cited docs cover PR reviews, the CLI, and the feedback widget only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
